title: VPN Remote Access Troubleshooting

signals.name: VPN handshake timeout
signals.rationale: Repeated VPN handshake timeouts point to remote access path or gateway instability.

signals.name: DNS failure after tunnel drop
signals.rationale: DNS failures after tunnel drop support VPN or internal name resolution triage.

signals.name: Multiple users affected
signals.rationale: Multiple affected users make a shared service issue more likely than a single device issue.

baselines.name: VPN handshake p95
baselines.rationale: Remote access handshake latency above this range can indicate gateway, client, or network path issues.

baselines.name: Tunnel packet loss
baselines.rationale: Sustained packet loss above 1 percent can degrade VPN, voice, and remote desktop sessions.

baselines.name: Internal DNS lookup
baselines.rationale: Slow internal DNS lookups after VPN connection indicate name resolution or tunnel health problems.

baselines.name: Authentication failure rate
baselines.rationale: Repeated authentication failures should be correlated with VPN policy and identity logs.

recommended_actions: Check for recent VPN policy or routing changes.
escalation_template: Escalate to Network Operations with affected users, handshake errors, DNS test results, and recent change window.
